analysis.purpose: The test suite for mcp-install — it defines the behaviour that is guaranteed, so a change that breaks any of it fails the build. It pins: installMcp — claude (project-scope .mcp.json); installMcp — cursor (project + global); installMcp — vscode/copilot (project-scope, servers + type:stdio); installMcp — codex (TOML, snake_case, absolute path, project + global).
responsibilities: Pin the observable behaviour of mcp-install
Fail the build when a guaranteed behaviour changes
